The camera keeps rising through the thin blue edge of the sky until the whole planet Earth hangs in black space. One unbroken aerial shot with no cuts.

# Effects: one photo to a short effect video on LTX 2.5

Locks your photo at frame 0, makes a matte of its subject, draws an end frame for the effect and renders one continuous shot in two stages on LTX 2.5. This file holds every part a recipe can use: an end frame drawn from the photo by FLUX.2 Klein 4B, and the subject held at the last frame through its matte. Each recipe in the Rosesfield catalog removes the parts it does not use.

- [ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/latent_upscale_models/ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors): LTX 2.5 latent upscaler, 2 times, [LTX-2.x Community License](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2/blob/main/LICENSE-2_x).

- [ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/vae/ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors): LTX 2.5 audio VAE, [LTX-2.x Community License](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2/blob/main/LICENSE-2_x).
- [gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/resolve/main/text_encoders/gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors): Gemma 4 12B text encoder with the LTX 2.5 projections, int8, [the licence of the LTX 2.5 repository it sits in](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5).
